blocks.text: Kisi madde ki enthalpy na sirf us ki tabee halat par balke dabao aur darja hararat par bhi munhasir hai, to muadla likhte waqt yeh halaat batane hote hain. Enthalpy tabdeeliyon ke durust muqable ke liye delta H miyari (standard) halaat mein tai hoti hai: 25 degrees C (298 K) darja hararat aur 1 atm (101 kPa) dabao.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain
blocks.text: Kisi unsur ki standard state 298 K aur 1 atm par us ki sab se mustahkam shakal hai; carbon ki standard state graphite hai, heera nahi. Tareef ke mutabiq apni standard state mein kisi bhi unsur ki standard enthalpy of formation sifar hai.

blocks.caption: Is topic ki standard enthalpy tabdeeliyan

blocks.prompt: Enthalpy tabdeeliyon ka muqabla standard halaat mein kyun karna chahiye, aur oxygen gas ki standard enthalpy of formation kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Enthalpy darja hararat, dabao aur tabee halat par munhasir hai, to mukhtalif halaat mein napi qeematon ka muqabla nahi ho sakta; 298 K aur 1 atm unhen muqarrar karte hain. Oxygen gas, O2, unsur ki standard state hai, to us ki standard enthalpy of formation tareef se sifar hai.

items: Standard halaat: 25 degrees C (298 K) aur 1 atm (101 kPa); unsur ki standard state us ki sab se mustahkam shakal hai (carbon ke liye graphite) aur us ki standard enthalpy of formation sifar.
